maria (AE): Heads-up: Prospect 'Aurora Systems' asked for a 3-week pilot. They want the POC checklist + what security artifacts we can share. Can we assemble quickly?
dinesh (Solutions): Yes. Need their primary goals and traffic profile to size model + infra.
maria (AE): Use cases: 1) triage & priority classification for incoming tickets, 2) short summarization (1-2 sentence), 3) semantic search via embeddings. Pilot volume ~50k messages/day. Region preference: eu-west.
claire (Security): For a pilot we can provide: DPA template, SOC2 Type II summary (redacted), network diagram showing eu-west hosting, KMS integration notes, and pen-test guidelines. If PHI is involved we'll need to escalate for a BAA.
tess (Legal): DPA: we’ll send our standard POC DPA. Expect ~3 business days turnaround once they return edits. Ask them who the legal contact is.
dinesh (Solutions): Suggested POC acceptance criteria: 
- classification F1 >= 0.82 on their labelled set
- summaries: BLEU/ROUGE-L improvement vs baseline >= 10%
- embeddings: recall@10 >= 0.75 on their search eval
- latency: p95 < 250ms for single requests
- stability: 48h continuous run with <1% errors
maria (AE): They also asked about cost for the pilot and whether we can keep all data in eu-west. Any constraints?
claire (Security): eu-west hosting is fine for Hosted API pilot. For strict data residency (no egress) we need Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) — that adds setup time and cost. For logs/raw request access: we require explicit approval; otherwise we provide aggregated anon samples.
tess (Legal): If they indicate HIPAA scope, we do not sign BAAs for free trials. That requires AE + Legal escalation and a different contract.
claire (Security): Pen-test ask: they want to run a light external pentest against pilot endpoints. Our standard flow:
```
- customer submits test plan + IP ranges
- agree time windows and allowed tests
- Redwood sec POC monitors during testing
- Redwood triages findings within 5 business days
```
We need them to avoid simulated heavy load that could affect production.
dinesh (Solutions): For the evals, request: small labelled sample (~500 examples) with expected labels and an unlabeled streaming sample for latency profiling. We'll run a few model configs and return an eval report.
infra-bot: created checklist: [DPA, SOC2-extract, eu-west-network-diagram, KMS-notes, pen-test-guidelines] (assigned: claire).
tess (Legal): Also confirm IP ownership: default is customer retains rights to inputs and outputs; clarify prompt/derivative IP in DPA/POC SOW.
maria (AE): Proposed timeline: Day 0-2 share docs; Day 3-7 receive eval set; Day 8-14 run pilot and share report. Can we meet that cadence?
dinesh (Solutions): Yes if we get the eval set by Mon. I'll draft the run plan today.
claire (Security): I'll assemble the SOC2 extract and pen-test one-pager by EOD.
tess (Legal): I'll queue the DPA for review.
maria (AE): I'll relay this to the customer and schedule a kickoff. Thanks all :thumbsup:
dinesh (Solutions): Quick cost note: Hosted pilot estimate ~ $1.2k/week for the stated volume; Private/VPC will be materially higher — I'll include numbers in the kickoff doc.
maria (AE): Great, I'll follow up after the call.
